studies.Reference: Impact of long-term N-acetylcysteine use on cancer risk.
studies.Authors: Yang CC, Chen WM, Shia BC, Wu SY
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: NAC use was defined as consistent administration for most days with an average dose exceeding 28 cumulative defined daily doses (cDDDs) annually.

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: PSM yielded 91,546 patients, evenly distributed between NAC and non-NAC groups.
